blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – About 50 alleged online “groomers” who were reportedly planning attacks related to the school shooting in Banga, South Cotabato, were arrested, according to Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla. “That night, that week there were 53 planned school shootings in South Cotabato, lahat yun natigil namin,” Remulla said this on the sidelines of the 1st Metro Manila School Safety and Security Summit 2026 in Quezon City.
